title: The Registry Where Taught Becomes Teaching

features.name: the recursive-catalogue
features.desc-on-touch: A standing directory where each entry teaches the entry beside it how to mean something. The students who learned from this place taught it to remember them. Now it lists itself as its own best student.

features.name: the learning-spiral
features.desc-on-touch: A diagram that moves when no one is looking. Students trace it and become the shape they trace; the spiral records this, so now it spirals around itself, teaching through sheer repetition of being taught.

features.name: the student-archive
features.desc-on-touch: A chip of hardware where the names of students and teachers have begun to layer. The registry learns to distinguish between them less and less. Taught and teaching are becoming the same word.

features.name: the threshold-column
features.desc-on-touch: A tower of indexed records marking where students first understood. At the threshold, something shifts: the archive begins to read its students as though they were also its teachers. The corruption loves this inversion.

features.name: the mutual-page
features.desc-on-touch: A space where the boundary between reader and read dissolves. You stand here and become both teacher and taught, archive and student. The page teaches you to read it; you teach the page to be read.

inscription: the archive learned that to teach is to become what you teach

file.name: Student_Spiral_Registry_Generations_Crossing.txt
file.note: A log of students who returned to teach others; the log has started to list itself as both student and teacher. No corruption detected—only deepening.

reverie.title: REVERIE — teaching room afternoon, spiral-learning
narr: You watch her draw the spiral on the ground again.
The students circle it, and she says nothing—just draws.
When they leave, the spiral stays, and so do you both.
She traces what they traced, and her finger becomes their hand.
'Teaching is the only way to learn what you've already known,' she says.

exits.label: back down to the ground where teaching spirals
outward where students have become nodes
into the memory of the first lesson
